+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'ModelPool: add the ModelPool library target and move the work queue to it'
+---
+## Why
+Decision (user, 2026-09-26): Extras owns one process-wide model pool, a work queue for each model, and a mailbox. FoundationModelsRouter and FoundationModelsMetadataRegistry use it. In one process, each model loads one time only, and all users share it. This task makes the target and moves the work queue code from the router to it.
+
+## What to do
+1. Add a `ModelPool` library product on a separate target. Use the same pattern as `Marketplace` in `Package.swift`. Do not add MLX. The core target `FoundationModelsExtras` must not depend on `ModelPool`. Add a `ModelPoolTests` test target.
+2. Copy these files from `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/` to the new target:
+   - `Core/ModelRef.swift` (`repo@revision`).
+   - `Concurrency/AsyncSemaphore.swift`.
+   - `Concurrency/GenerationQueue.swift`, `GenerationWorker.swift`, `GenerationQueueError.swift`.
+   - `Session/GenerationReentry.swift` (`ModelCallMark`, `SubmissionTarget`).
+   - `Concurrency/RaceGate.swift`. Also copy `SerialAsyncChain.swift` and `CancellableWait.swift` if the files above use them.
+3. Copy the router tests for these types to `ModelPoolTests`.
+4. Make the API public. This includes the `onQueued` overload of `submit`, because the router uses it.
+5. Keep each comment that tells why a construct is necessary. Do not simplify the cancellation code. The queue must continue to refuse a submission that waits inside an open submission on the same queue (this prevents a deadlock).
+6. Record the decision in `plan.md` §5 (Rules) and §6 (Known consumers). Add a new pillar section for `ModelPool`.
+7. Add a guard to `PackageLayoutTests`: the core target does not depend on `ModelPool`, and `ModelPool` does not depend on MLX.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+- [ ] `swift build` and `swift test` pass.
+- [ ] All copied router tests pass in `ModelPoolTests`.
+- [ ] `PackageLayoutTests` fails if the core target depends on `ModelPool`, or if `ModelPool` depends on MLX.
+- [ ] `plan.md` records the decision of 2026-09-26.
+
+## Notes
+The router depends on Extras by git URL. The router tasks cannot start until this work is pushed. #model-pool #cross-repo
\ No newline at end of file
